prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: genuine painted 2D terrain/background plate for a functional Noxian Heroes of Might and Magic III town, exact native ratio 800 x 374. Generate a NEW backdrop, not a flattened finished town. This will have 36 separate existing building sprites placed over it.

Reference image 1 (placement-buildings-native) shows exact planned positions and scale of the SEPARATE functional buildings, solely for layout/material/lighting matching. DO NOT paint/copy these buildings into the output. Image 2 is an engineering guide: gray irregular silhouettes are reserved SEPARATE BUILDING VOLUMES, turquoise outlines are not art, ochre lines mark approximate connecting pedestrian lanes; all marks must disappear. Use each building's ground-contact at its bottom edge to plan actual land and doorway approaches. Image 3 is original Heroes III Castle background for native painted detail/camera/surface treatment ONLY: do not copy its landscape, skyline, palette or pixels. Noxus is a distinct charcoal basalt, black iron, worn dark stone and crimson-cloth imperial military city with warm window light and restrained forge flames.

Create an ORGANIC COMPACT INHABITED NOXIAN URBAN NEIGHBORHOOD. Dark threatening smoky red sky, distant layered imperial fortress skyline and city rooftops, smoke and scattered warm ember lights along the upper horizon. Strong depth but no pale atmospheric haze over the playable floor. In the actual mid/near neighborhood, CONTINUOUS dark cobbled/paved pedestrian streets, subtle irregular courts, worn stone gutters, connected steps only at appropriate level changes, supplies/barrels and tiny context details on unreserved street edges. Avoid a broad featureless plaza or regular horizontal terrace rows. Make neighboring functional buildings feel linked by shared alleys, street frontage and community spaces, rather than isolated catalogue buildings. A few NONFUNCTIONAL very small incidental rooflines behind main plots and far away establish urban density; no extra large freestanding towers. Three public crimson civic banners bearing recognizable Noxian silver crests integrated on narrow street-side posts outside reserved silhouettes, not free-floating emblems; do not use generic tridents.

Keep every planned full-building silhouette and contact shadow completely free of incidental architecture, trees, railing walls or cliff faces. Reserve level supported dry stone ground under EVERY building base. Critically, all front doors/stair feet (shown on image 1) must open onto real continuous visible street aprons, no vertical retaining wall blocking any entrance. Preserve interconnected narrow streets around the silhouettes including a curved diagonal avenue through center-right, linking foreground to the rear civic court. Rear hall and bastion stand on supported urban ground, not mountain tops or floating ledges. Ground should continue beneath the absent sprites; DO NOT make gray shaped cutouts, empty holes, labels, colored guide lines, regular numbered plots or rectangular pads. Treat this as a clean empty game terrain plate that looks natural before construction, with open planned land where buildings will be overlaid. The silhouette shapes reserve volume; they are not floor designs to trace in cobbles. No fort/capitol/arena/workshop baked into these functional sites.

Coast is ONLY a tiny far-right water inlet around native x788..800,y151..203 for the optional dock, all remaining land dry, especially the entire bastion base above y136. Keep the right edge access to that inlet. Not a sea cliff scene. Low theatrical three-quarter matte-painted projection, slightly elevated horizon, readable front facades to be added, warm upper-left firelit accents, physically large rear institutions but exaggerated foreground apparent scale. Match textured original HoMM3 surfaces/readability at actual 800x374, not ultra-detailed cinematic splash art. Output clean native-composition BACKGROUND ONLY at ratio 800:374. Absolutely no UI, text, frame, modern 3D, Blender, geometric/vector illustration, glossy render, neon bloom, lens distortion, isometric board, modern realistic camera or painted functional buildings.
selection: v3 selected as candidate; earlier variants preserved as rejected studies
